name: Masked reveal
what: Text that rises into place from behind an invisible edge - line by line, word by word or letter by letter - each piece sliding up out of its line with a small tilt that straightens; it pushes in slowly while it holds, and at the end the pieces slide up out of their lines. Accent words in an italic serif.
origin: MotionLab's own build of the masked line / word / letter reveal of GSAP SplitText (its mask option) and the masked-reveal web pattern - the user asked for text that appears word by word or similar (2026-10-31)
motion: from f0 the pieces (words by default, one every gap = 3 f; letters a third of it, lines twice) rise 1.36 em from under their line's edge into place over 16 f (12 f a letter), decelerating hard (slow end), a 7 degree tilt (3 for a line) straightening as they land; the text pushes in 3 % over the hold (gentle S-curve); at the end the pieces slide on up out of their lines one after another, 10 f each (accelerating)

tracks.name: rise
tracks.what: the words rise into place one after another

tracks.name: out
tracks.what: the words slide on up out of their lines

min_frames: start + round(((len(text) * gap / 3 if by == 'letters' else (parts(text, '|') * gap * 2 if by == 'lines' else (parts(text, ' ') + parts(text, '|') - 1) * gap)) + 20) * fps / 30)
min_why: every piece has to rise in before it ends
